当您需要实现设备内的跨进程通信（如后台服务与前台应用之间的接口调用和数据传递）时，可使用 IPC Kit 的 IPC 能力
当您需要实现跨设备的远程过程调用（如多端协同场景下的远端接口调用和数据传递）时，可使用 RPC 能力
当您需要监听远端服务进程的死亡状态以便及时处理连接中断时，可使用远端状态订阅能力
实现前台页面调用后台服务能力并返回结果 / Implement front-end page calls to a background service and get results back
用 RemoteObject 暴露应用服务接口给其他进程调用 / Expose app service APIs to other processes with RemoteObject
通过 MessageParcel 传递自定义对象和参数 / Pass custom objects and arguments with MessageParcel
在 ArkTS 中编写 Proxy/Stub 封装跨进程接口 / Build Proxy/Stub wrappers for cross-process APIs in ArkTS
用匿名共享内存传输大块图片或二进制数据 / Transfer large images or binary data with anonymous shared memory
订阅远程对象死亡回调并在服务断开后重连 / Subscribe to remote object death notifications and reconnect after service loss
实现应用与系统能力之间的远程方法调用 / Implement remote method invocation between the app and system abilities
在不同应用进程之间发送请求并接收回包 / Send requests and receive replies between different app processes
接入跨设备远程服务调用以同步数据或执行操作 / Integrate cross-device remote service calls to sync data or perform actions
管理 IPC 接口码和事务分发逻辑 / Manage IPC interface codes and transaction dispatch logic
序列化复杂结构体后通过 Parcel 跨进程传输 / Serialize complex structs and send them across processes via Parcel
让独立进程中的模块共享同一套服务能力 / Let modules in separate processes share the same service capability
do_not_use_when: 需求是做多路并发联网、无缝网络迁移、QoS 评估、弱网感知或链路流量优化，应改用 network-boost-kit / The task is about multipath networking, seamless connection migration, QoS evaluation, weak-network awareness, or traffic optimization; use network-boost-kit instead

需求是接入蓝牙/BLE、Wi‑Fi STA/P2P/AP 或 NFC 标签读写与卡模拟等短距无线能力，应改用 connectivity-kit / The task is about Bluetooth/BLE, Wi-Fi STA/P2P/AP, or NFC tag reading/writing and card emulation for short-range wireless features; use connectivity-kit instead
preconditions: 应用工程已具备 HarmonyOS IPC/RPC 可用的 API 版本与对应 SDK 能力 / The project targets an HarmonyOS API version and SDK capability that support IPC/RPC
客户端与服务端已约定一致的接口描述、事务码和序列化数据结构 / The client and service have agreed on the same interface contract, transaction codes, and parcelable data structures
若进行跨设备 RPC，相关设备发现/连接环境已就绪且分布式通信链路可用 / For cross-device RPC, device discovery/connection setup is ready and the distributed communication link is available
若使用远端状态订阅，已持有有效远端对象引用并完成回调注册条件准备 / If remote death subscription is used, a valid remote object reference is available and callback registration prerequisites are met
inputs: 远端对象或服务端对象引用 / remote object or service-side object reference
MessageParcel/序列化请求数据 / MessageParcel or serialized request data
接口描述符与事务码 / interface descriptor and transaction code
跨设备目标标识（如设备信息） / cross-device target identifier (such as device information)
死亡通知回调对象 / death recipient callback object
outputs: 服务端导出的远程对象句柄（IRemoteObject / RemoteObject / Stub 引用） / Remote object handle exported by the service (IRemoteObject / RemoteObject / Stub reference)
客户端用于发起调用的 Proxy 代理对象 / Client-side Proxy object used to initiate IPC/RPC calls
请求数据包与应答数据包（MessageParcel / MessageSequence / IPC Parcel） / Request and reply parcels carrying marshalled data (MessageParcel / MessageSequence / IPC Parcel)
远程调用返回结果（业务返回值、状态码、错误码） / Remote call result, including business return values, status codes, and error codes
sendRequest / sendMessageRequest 的应答对象或结果对象 / Response or result object returned by sendRequest / sendMessageRequest
远端 Stub 对象死亡通知回调（DeathRecipient / 死亡状态通知） / Remote Stub death notification callback (DeathRecipient / death status notification)
用于大数据传输的匿名共享内存对象或句柄 / Anonymous shared memory object or handle for large data transfer
C/C++ IPC/RPC 句柄对象（远程代理、远程 Stub、Parcel 等） / C/C++ IPC/RPC handle objects such as remote proxy, remote Stub, and Parcel

postconditions.statement: 已新增或修改 Proxy/Stub、IRemoteObject、MessageParcel 等 IPC/RPC 相关代码，而非仅停留在普通业务逻辑 / IPC/RPC-specific code such as Proxy/Stub, IRemoteObject, or MessageParcel has been added or modified rather than only general business logic
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly introduce or modify HarmonyOS IPC/RPC constructs such as Proxy, Stub, IRemoteObject, MessageParcel, sendRequest, or equivalent C/C++ IPC APIs?

postconditions.statement: 客户端请求与服务端处理的接口契约保持一致，包含相同的接口标识、事务码或读写顺序 / The client request and service handler use a consistent interface contract, including matching interface identifier, transaction code, or parcel read/write order
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there evidence that the client and server sides follow the same IPC/RPC contract, such as matching descriptor/transaction IDs and compatible parcel serialization order?

postconditions.statement: 跨设备或远端场景下已补充连接异常/远端死亡等失败处理逻辑（如适用） / Failure handling for remote scenarios, such as connection interruption or remote object death, has been added when applicable
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits involve remote or cross-device IPC/RPC, do they also add handling for failures such as remote death, connection interruption, or request errors?
